_comment: Engine-ECU families that carry the immobiliser PIN, for the ECU & Immobiliser reference. MCU/memory/PIN facts are the established ECU-family characteristics; 'makes' and 'corpus' are what a field reference corpus of ~434 tuning dumps (local, not published) actually showed. A family links to its KAT PIN page where KAT has documented where the PIN is stored. No dumps, VINs or PINs are published here.

families.pin: PIN in the EEPROM (3 XOR-masked copies)
families.note: Early common-rail diesel. KAT's PSA PIN method is confirmed on a real EDC15C2.

families.pin: PIN in the EEPROM (3 XOR-masked copies)
families.note: The mainstream 2000s diesel ECU. KAT's PSA PIN method is internally consistent, not yet confirmed on a PSA dump.

families.memory: internal data flash (+ external 95128/95256 on some)
families.pin: in the TriCore flash / NvM, not a plain serial EEPROM
families.note: The most common family in the corpus. Read by BDM/boot-mode or OBD; PIN handling is model-specific.

families.pin: ME7.4.4 (PSA): PIN plain in the EEPROM + mirror
families.note: Petrol multipoint injection. KAT documents the PSA ME7.4.4 PIN location.

families.pin: in the TriCore flash / NvM (MEV17.4 is the PSA/Mini 'Prince' petrol ECU)
families.note: Petrol direct injection (TFSI / THP). MED17.5 variants are the VAG petrol mainstream.

families.pin: SID803 (PSA): PIN plain in the 95320 EEPROM
families.note: SID801/803/805/807 diesel. KAT documents the SID803 PIN location; SID807 is a later TriCore variant.
SID305 / SID306, the Renault/Nissan dCi diesel ECU.
The VAG pump-düse (PD) diesel ECU; read by BDM/boot-mode.
The VAG common-rail diesel ECU after the PD generation.
The Fiat-group MultiJet diesel ECU (MJD 6F3/8F3 …). The EEPROM carries the immo data (a 4 KB e2p is in the corpus).
The Fiat-group petrol ECU. KAT documents the TMS374 immo repair.
The Delphi common-rail diesel ECU (DCM3.4 / 3.5), common on Renault and Korean diesels.
